title.zh: Circle and Tether find common ground against MiCA’s bank reserve rules
title.en: Circle and Tether find common ground against MiCA’s bank reserve rules

current_state.zh: Circle and Tether are jointly lobbying the EU to amend MiCA so that recognized non-EU stablecoin issuers can distribute tokens in Europe under a lighter recognition regime and to loosen reserve rules that currently limit global issuers.
current_state.en: Circle and Tether are jointly lobbying the EU to amend MiCA so that recognized non-EU stablecoin issuers can distribute tokens in Europe under a lighter recognition regime and to loosen reserve rules that currently limit global issuers.
